families.protected_boundary: Existing source-specific old-path absence and replacement checks until generic manifest, authority, link, and Git-recoverability validation supersedes them.
families.removal_gate: Every protected old path has a generic retirement-manifest entry or reviewed current disposition, equivalent generic validation is green, and no current workflow consumer remains.

families.protected_boundary: Structural integrity of already-committed completion reports: accepted historical metadata profiles, required sections, concrete source-PR evidence, and unresolved-placeholder rejection. This family owns no model, template, current-status, architecture, contract, or new-report creation authority.
families.removal_gate: Every existing completion report has a reviewed D2-D6 synthesis, allowlisted record classification, or Git-retirement disposition; no workflow, consolidated smoke group, current architecture procedure, or operator consumes the validator; and generic authority, links, record, and Git-recoverability validation protects every continuing invariant.

families.protected_boundary: Commit-fixed legacy classification, normative candidate extraction, and link-dependency evidence still referenced by unfinished source families.
current_consumers: bounded D2-D6 source-family synthesis and retirement reviews
families.removal_gate: All remaining sources are governed by the canonical active graph, generic normative extraction, generic link checks, and the retirement manifest.

families.protected_boundary: Legacy one-document cutover provenance until its durable fields are represented by the generic retirement manifest or an allowlisted retained record.
families.removal_gate: All continuing recovery or audit facts are represented by allowlisted records, and historical-only narratives remain recoverable from Git.
